lines.key: stay composed as the level builds
lines.text: Stay composed as the level builds

lines.key: good work recover for the next level
lines.text: Good work. Recover for the next level.

lines.key: stay loose the next level is coming
lines.text: Stay loose. The next level is coming.

lines.key: control your breathing and keep moving
lines.text: Control your breathing and keep moving

lines.key: reset your guard and get ready
lines.text: Reset your guard and get ready

lines.key: repeat each assignment at a controlled pace until the next callout return the lead hand to guard and keep moving between repetitions
lines.text: Repeat each assignment at a controlled pace until the next callout. Return the lead hand to guard and keep moving between repetitions.

lines.key: repeat the called straight punch pattern until the next callout change level with your knees for body shots and return both hands to guard
lines.text: Repeat the called straight-punch pattern until the next callout. Change level with your knees for body shots and return both hands to guard.

lines.key: repeat the called hook pattern until the next callout keep the punches compact rotate through your feet and protect your chin with the opposite hand
lines.text: Repeat the called hook pattern until the next callout. Keep the punches compact, rotate through your feet, and protect your chin with the opposite hand.

lines.key: work close to the bag and repeat the assignment until the next callout keep hooks and uppercuts short stay balanced and reset your guard after every combination
lines.text: Work close to the bag and repeat the assignment until the next callout. Keep hooks and uppercuts short, stay balanced, and reset your guard after every combination.

lines.key: follow the effort named and keep working until the next callout technique means controlled clean punches speed means fast light punches power means strong balanced shots and movement means active recovery around the bag
lines.text: Follow the effort named and keep working until the next callout. Technique means controlled clean punches, speed means fast light punches, power means strong balanced shots, and movement means active recovery around the bag.

lines.key: imagine the incoming punch perform the defense first then throw the counter repeat the complete reaction until the next callout and return to your stance each time
lines.text: Imagine the incoming punch, perform the defense first, then throw the counter. Repeat the complete reaction until the next callout and return to your stance each time.

lines.key: repeat the complete movement and punch assignment until the next callout keep your feet from crossing and finish every repetition balanced in your boxing stance
lines.text: Repeat the complete movement and punch assignment until the next callout. Keep your feet from crossing and finish every repetition balanced in your boxing stance.
